gloss: receipt; receiving; acceptance (of goods, documents, payment)

definitions.gloss: receipt; receiving; acceptance (of goods, documents, payment)

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}を{受領|じゅりょう}した。
{荷物|にもつ}の{受領|じゅりょう}にはサインが{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: A signature is required to receive the package.

examples.japanese: {受領|じゅりょう}{確認|かくにん}のメールを{送|おく}りましたので、ご{確認|かくにん}ください。
examples.english: I sent a receipt confirmation email, so please check it.

notes:
A formal term for the act of receiving goods, documents, or payments. Used primarily in business and official contexts. Much more formal than {受|う}け{取|と}る.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受領|じゅりょう}する: to receive (formal)
- {受領書|じゅりょうしょ}: receipt (document)
- {受領証|じゅりょうしょう}: certificate of receipt
- {受領|じゅりょう}{確認|かくにん}: receipt confirmation
- {受領|じゅりょう}{日|び}: date of receipt

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {受|う}け{取|と}る: to receive — the everyday, general word for receiving
- {受理|じゅり}: acceptance/receipt — specifically for official applications and documents being formally accepted by an authority
- {領収|りょうしゅう}: receipt (of payment) — specifically for money; {領収書|りょうしゅうしょ} is the standard word for a payment receipt
